$comment: The skill shape docs/PROCESS.md section The skill shape states, as data (zheref/hatsu#502; SDD plan wave 4, assessment finding B6). Each requirement matches a level-2 heading whose title, after an optional `N.` number, is the section's name or a list of the three names joined by `,`, `and` or `&` (`## 6. Authority and hard limits` satisfies two), optionally followed by ` — ` and a gloss; a heading that only mentions the word (`## 1. Invocation and authority`) is not the section. scripts/skill_shape_check.mts hands each touched SKILL.md to `nen pr body-check --body-from <SKILL.md> --requirements-from <these requirements>`, so the heading match is nen's. Keys, exemptions and the check: docs/config/skill-shape.json.md.
$exemptions: One entry per skill that may lack a section: {"skill": "<claude/skills directory name>", "sections": ["<a requirement name above>", ...], "reason": "<why this skill has no such section>"}. An entry with no reason, an empty reason, an unknown skill or section, a section the skill in fact carries when it is checked, or a section the base revision's list did not carry (the list only shrinks) fails the check by name. An empty list is a decision: no skill is exempt.
